group.name: UPSC (Union Public Service Commission)
group.intro: Is part ke zyada tar exams Level 10 ki Group A posts tak le jaate hain, par sab nahi: EPFO Enforcement / Accounts Officer Level 8 ki Group B post hai, aur NDA aur CDS se commissioned rank training ke baad hi milti hai. Haal ke notices mein fee ₹100 (CSE, NDA) ya ₹200 (CDS, CAPF, ESE, CMS aur baaki) hai; mahilayein, SC, ST aur PwBD ko chhoot hai. upsc.gov.in par one-time registration se apply karein. Negative marking question ke marks ka 1/3 hai.
group.ageRelaxation.rows.7.rule: CAPF aur Railway: pehle batch ke liye 5 saal tak, uske baad 3 saal
group.ageRelaxation.notes.0: Final-year students aam taur par graduate exams mein apply kar sakte hain, agar notice ki cut-off date tak unke paas degree hogi.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.1: Central exams mein EWS ko reservation milta hai, lekin age relaxation nahi.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.2: OBC relaxation sirf Non-Creamy Layer ko milta hai, valid central-format certificate ke saath.
